versions.content: Handling if attemption to enable / disable the transmission secure association at an PHY has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthTrcv_MacSecAddTxSa was called for an EthTrcvConfig with EthTrcv- MacSecEnabled set to TRUE and attempts to add a transmission secure association and to enable or disable of this transmission secure association for the corresponding PHY has been successfully finalized, then the EthTrcv driver shall notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_MacSecAddTxSaNotification with CtrlIdx set to the correspond- ing EthIfController and Result set to E_OK . Otherwise the EthTrcv driver shall call EthIf_MacSecAddTxSaNotification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
